# docs commands

Every `docs` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `docs:get`

Get a canonical Semitexa document as Markdown or HTML

```bash
bin/semitexa docs:get "<document-id>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--format` | yes |
| `--locale` | yes |

## `docs:lint`

Check documented attributes, commands and env keys against the framework surface

```bash
bin/semitexa docs:lint
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--path` | yes |
| `--index` | yes |
| `--baseline` | yes |
| `--write-baseline` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `docs:list`

List canonical Semitexa documents by section

```bash
bin/semitexa docs:list
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |
| `--locale` | yes |

## `docs:reference:generate`

Generate the reference section (attributes, commands, events) from the truth index

```bash
bin/semitexa docs:reference:generate
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--out` | yes |
| `--check` | no |

## `docs:show-section`

Show canonical documents for one Docs section

```bash
bin/semitexa docs:show-section "<section>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |
| `--locale` | yes |

## `docs:truth-index`

Emit the framework public surface (attributes, commands, contracts, routes, events, env keys, Twig) as JSON

```bash
bin/semitexa docs:truth-index
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |
| `--out` | yes |
